item.title: ‘Black or White’ 4K Re-Upload Restores Original Vision
item.description: The "Black or White" 4K upscale has been updated. The car graffiti is removed and the uncensored panther dance returns, finally honoring Michael's original vision.

item.title: New ‘Michael’ Movie Poster
item.description: Lionsgate drops a new 'Michael' poster with Jaafar Jackson in iconic 'Beat It' gear. Directed by Antoine Fuqua, the biopic hits theaters and IMAX on April 24, 2026.

item.title: Another New ‘Michael’ Biopic Poster Released
item.description: Lionsgate have released yet another new poster for the upcoming biopic movie "Michael", depicting Jaafar Jackson performing as Michael during the Bad World Tour.

item.title: Watch The Full Trailer For The ‘Michael’ Biopic
item.description: Lionsgate has unveiled the full trailer for "Michael," starring Jaafar Jackson. Witness the rise of the King of Pop before the film hits theaters April 24, 2026.

item.title: ‘Michael’ Biopic Movie First Look
item.description: Get an exclusive first look at the 'Michael' biopic. Producer Graham King and director Antoine Fuqua discuss Jaafar Jackson’s "calling" to play his famous uncle.

item.title: Antoine Fuqua Talks About Making ‘Michael’
item.description: Explore Antoine Fuqua’s vision for *Michael* (2026). The film goes beyond the King of Pop’s fame to reveal the human struggles and global magic of a "no ceiling" icon.

item.title: New Teaser Trailer For Early Access
item.description: Experience the rise of the King of Pop in Michael (2026). Jaafar Jackson stars in this biopic tracing MJ’s journey from Gary to global superstardom.

item.title: ‘Michael’ Soundtrack
item.description: The "Michael" biopic soundtrack arrives will be a 13-track collection spans Jackson 5 hits to "Bad", available on vinyl, CD, and tape. Pre-order your copy now.

item.title: Jaafar Talks About Becoming Michael Jackson
item.description: Go behind the scenes of the "Michael" biopic as Jaafar Jackson discusses his intense journey and rigorous rehearsals to authentically portray his uncle Michael.

item.title: Special Edition Time Magazine on Michael
item.description: TIME’s new special edition, "Michael Jackson: His Music, His Life & His Legacy," honors Michael’s iconic career, from the Jackson 5 to his solo global superstardom.
